email.subject: Forge Group Fitness: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

I looked at Forge Group Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: it's not mobile-friendly, and there's no way to book a class online. Most people searching for a gym on their phone will give up and try a competitor if they can't quickly see hours or book a spot.

I also noticed no reviews are shown and the footer looks outdated.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix? No pressure either way.

Alex
